subject: AtlasPay — security evidence & action plan
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jenny Mueller <jenny.mueller@atlaspay.com>, procurement@atlaspay.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 15:23:00 +0000
Subject: AtlasPay — security evidence & action plan

Jenny — thanks for the time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth.

What we heard (pain & goals)
- SOC 2: AtlasPay needs a vendor with Type II evidence or a bridge plan to satisfy audit next quarter.
- Audit logs & retention: must retain transaction and admin audit logs for 7 years; logs need to include user identifiers (email) and request/response timestamps.
- Data residency & DPA: legal requires a DPA with explicit retention and subprocessors list.
- Pen test evidence: procurement wants a high-level pen test summary and confirmation of remediations.

What Redwood will provide (next 72-96 hours)
- SOC2-summary-2026.pdf: scope, last assessment date, control owner contacts. (attached)
- audit-log-sample.csv: redacted example of the audit export showing fields and retention policy. (attached)
- DPA-draft-AtlasPay.docx: initial DPA template with retention and KMS language. (will share; attached version in this thread)
- Inventory: list of subprocessors and regions.

Asks / next steps
1) Please confirm priority and the target date for your audit acceptance (approx date).
2) Procurement: confirm preferred contract path (PO + SOW or DocuSign subscription).
3) Security: any additional evidence you require beyond SOC2 summary, pen test summary, and audit logs?
4) Can we schedule a 30-min technical follow-up next week to walk audit-log schema and KMS/HSM details?

Attachments: SOC2-summary-2026.pdf, audit-log-sample.csv, DPA-draft-AtlasPay.docx (draft).

Thanks — happy to iterate.

-- 
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182


From: Jenny Mueller <jenny.mueller@atlaspay.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlaspay.com
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: AtlasPay — security evidence & action plan

Thanks Marcus — useful recap. A few clarifying items from our security team:

- KMS/HSM: Can you confirm whether customer data keys are managed in our tenant or by Redwood? We need high-level architecture and whether keys are customer-managed (bring your own key) or Redwood-managed.
- Audit log content: the sample looks good; will the logs include end-user email and the full request path?
- SSO/SCIM: we will require SSO with user provisioning if we proceed.

Procurement: please confirm that procurement@atlaspay.com is the correct contact and that PO flow is acceptable.

We can do the technical follow-up next Wed 10–11am ET if that works for you.

Jenny Mueller
Head of IT Security | AtlasPay
jenny.mueller@atlaspay.com

Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AtlasPay — security evidence & action plan

Jenny — appreciate the quick turn. Attached are the artifacts Laura and Sergio prepared: DPA-draft-AtlasPay.docx (initial DPA with retention and subprocessors list), SOC2-summary-2026.pdf, and audit-log-sample.csv.

Quick answers:
- KMS/HSM: Redwood supports both Redwood-managed keys and customer-managed keys (BYOK). Laura will attach architecture notes describing key scoping, HSM provider, and key rotation cadence.
- Audit logs: exported logs include timestamp, actor_email, request_path, resource_id, response_code, and retention metadata. The sample demonstrates redaction of payloads but preservation of identifiers.
- SSO/SCIM: we support SAML2.0 + SCIM for provisioning; we will share the integration guide prior to the call.

Next steps:
1) Security technical call: Wed Mar 3, 2027, 10:00am ET — proposed attendees: Jenny, AtlasPay security lead, Laura, Sergio. Marcus to send calendar invite.
2) Procurement: Marcus to send DPA + initial commercial terms; procurement to confirm PO vs subscription.
3) Evidence request: Jenny, please confirm the final list; if pen test report (redacted) is required we can share a redacted summary and attestations.

Related links: https://redwood.app/s/atlaspay-demo (demo recording & docs), docusign://envelope/0X12345 (DPA will go to DocuSign once legal confirms).

Attachments: DPA-draft-AtlasPay.docx, SOC2-summary-2026.pdf, audit-log-sample.csv, evidence-mapping-ATLP.csv

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

--
